text:
Ava: thinking out loud — we need a low-friction path to retire api/v1 text-generation without breaking 3rd-party SDKs. Proposal: staged shepherding: gateway rewrite -> client opt-in -> runtime graceful fallback. Thoughts?

Leo: +1 on staged. main Q: gateway vs runtime shim? Gateway simpler but opaque to telemetry.

Maya: runtime shim keeps signal at the runtime layer for SLOs, easier to do KV cache migration. downside: more churn in infra, needs hot path testing.

Ravi: concern: per-tenant opt-in increases surface area. Could we do a tenant cohort + per-tenant flag + auto-rollback on error-rate bump?

Denise: what metrics to watch? suggestion: request success ratio, 99th latency delta, token-cost delta, downstream model mismatch rate. Also prompt-regression eval set.

Ava: agree. We'll wire canaries: 1% active users for 48h -> 10% for week -> ramp. Rollout gating: error-rate > 1% or latency > +50ms -> rollback.

Maya: for opt-in, config example:
```
feature_flags:
  api_v2_migration:
    cohort: "bluegreen"
    max_qps: 500
    auto_rollback: true
```

Leo: telemetry: tag requests with migration_stage, recorded in tracing and logs. Add a small sampling for full request bodies for regression.

Ravi: ops-bot: can we get a runbook entry for rollback hooks + incident alert thresholds? @ops-bot

ops-bot: created runbook ticket INC-2024-118, linked in #incidents.automation :white_check_mark:

Denise: docs: add migration checklist for customers and SDK patch notes. Also plan a 6-week deprecation notice before forced cutover.

Ava: next steps: draft RFC with runbook, telemetry schema, cohort plan. I'll tag people for review by EOD Friday. :memo:
